create.name: Lucia Horan
create.bio:
Lucia Horan was born at Esalen in Big Sur in 1976 and grew up inside its community, qualifying in Esalen massage as a teenager and later as a teacher of Hatha and Ashtanga yoga. Her main work comes from many years of study with Gabrielle Roth, who created the 5Rhythms dance practice, and she has led 5Rhythms classes since 1998. Since 2005 she has also followed the Theravada insight meditation path, learning chiefly from Robert Hall, and she has completed a Buddhist teacher training in the Western lineage associated with Noah Levine and Jack Kornfield. Her essay on movement and insight appears in the anthology Dancing with Dharma, edited by Harrison Blum.

In her classes the five rhythms of Flowing, Staccato, Chaos, Lyrical and Stillness are paired with periods of seated meditation, and she often frames the dance around the Buddhist heart qualities of kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity. She describes herself as a fellow practitioner rather than a master. Now based in Wellington, New Zealand, with her husband and fellow 5Rhythms teacher Douglas Drummond, she runs local class series there and travels to lead weekend workshops and week-long retreats in the United States, Europe and at Esalen. Filmed sessions of her Heartbeat series are sold online, and she mentors dancers and newer 5Rhythms teachers.

books.title: Dancing with Dharma: Essays on Movement and Dance in Western Buddhism
books.author: Harrison Blum (editor), with Lucia Horan and others
books.description: An anthology from McFarland in which Buddhist practitioners and dance teachers write about how moving the body fits with meditation practice in the West. Lucia Horan contributes a chapter drawing on her years of joining 5Rhythms dance with insight meditation.

courses.title: Gateways: A 5Rhythms® Movement & Mindfulness Retreat
courses.description: A seven-day New Year retreat at Esalen in Big Sur, co-led with Douglas Drummond and accompanied by live drummers and musicians. Long sessions of 5Rhythms dance alternate with sitting practice, marking the turn of the year. Beginners are welcome.
courses.price: From $940 USD (all-inclusive), plus $120 USD faculty tuition

courses.title: Trance & Transformation: A 5Rhythms® & Mindfulness Immersion
courses.description: A three-day residential weekend at The Horse Shoe Farm near Hendersonville, North Carolina, with singer Leah Song of Rising Appalachia as guest. The days weave dance, mindfulness, song and stillness.

courses.title: Maps to Ecstasy: A 5Rhythms Weekend with Lucia Horan and Leah Song
courses.description: A non-residential weekend workshop at the Moving in the Spirit studio in Atlanta, shared with Leah Song. It brings together 5Rhythms dance, meditation and group singing.

courses.title: 5Rhythms® Heartbeat All 5 Sessions
courses.description: Five filmed classes of roughly two and a half hours each, recorded live, that move through the emotional map Gabrielle Roth called Heartbeat. Buyers receive a private link to stream the recordings; single sessions can also be bought separately.

courses.title: 5Rhythms Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one guidance for dancers who want to understand their own practice of the 5Rhythms more fully. Sessions offer themes and exercises to take into class and a closer look at the philosophy behind Roth's maps.

courses.title: 5Rhythms Teacher Mentoring
courses.description: Mentoring for certified or trainee 5Rhythms teachers. It covers holding workshops and retreats, music and sound, explaining the practice clearly, and keeping a group safe.
